welcome.title: Your next step starts here
welcome.description: Choose what you want to do. We’ll show you the first three steps.
welcome.playerDescription: Analyse your kick and find your next training focus.
welcome.coachDescription: Set up a team and follow your players’ progress.

upload.title: Start with one kick
upload.description: Film one kick from the side at 90°, with your whole body and the ball visible. Upload the clip to start analysis.
upload.tip: MP4, MOV, AVI or MKV · up to 50 MB.

results.title: See what to work on
results.description: After processing, your breakdown shows stability, power, technique and balance. Watch the video alongside your results.
results.tip: Each metric is scored from 0 to 100.

training.title: Train, film, see your progress
training.description: Choose drills from your results, then film another kick from the same angle. Compare your analyses to see what changes.
training.tip: Start with one area you want to improve.

team.title: Start with your team
team.description: Select a team to open its workspace. This is where you manage your squad and follow its progress.
team.emptyDescription: Create your first team to open a workspace for your squad and its progress.
team.tip: Switch teams here whenever you need to.

invite.title: Bring your players together
invite.description: Share your team’s invitation link or code. Players can use either to join your squad.
invite.emptyDescription: Once your team is created, share its invitation link or code so players can join.
invite.tip: The invitation link and code become available after team creation.

workspace.title: Follow the squad’s next steps
workspace.description: Use Squad, Statistics and Training to see your players, review their development and plan sessions.
workspace.emptyDescription: Squad, Statistics and Training bring your team’s activity together as players join and add analyses.
workspace.tip: Start with your squad, then open a player for more detail.
